question: 对比一下 top5
sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(o.amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: 销量排名前
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(o.quantity) AS 销量 FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 销量 DESC LIMIT 10

question: 各地区的情况
sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_amount, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM orders GROUP BY region LIMIT 1000
